mapper.select: SELECT notification_id, office_id, notification_type_code, title, content, read_yn, created_at, read_at FROM notification WHERE office_id = #{office_id} ORDER BY created_at DESC, notification_id DESC
SELECT notification_id, office_id, notification_type_code, title, content, read_yn, created_at, read_at FROM notification WHERE notification_id = #{notification_id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO notification ( office_id, notification_type_code, title, content, read_yn, created_at ) VALUES ( #{office_id}, #{notification_type_code}, #{title}, #{content}, 'N', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP )
mapper.update: UPDATE notification SET read_yn = 'Y', read_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE notification_id = #{notification_id} AND read_yn = 'N'
